table.retrieve:
select  	
			suppliercategory=sc.name,
			code1=cstatus.acccode, 
			aliasname=AC.AliasName,
			name1=ac.name, 
			value1=cstatus.opbalance, 
			value2=cstatus.debits, 
			pramt=cstatus.pramt, 
			value3=cstatus.credits,
			value4=cstatus.clbalance
from 
	accounts ac
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Supplier AS S ON (ac.acccode = s.suppcode), 
	(select acccode, sum(opbalance) as opbalance, sum(debits) as debits, sum(pr) as pramt, 
		sum(credits) as credits, sum(clbalance) as clbalance
		from 
			(select acccode, opbalance = sum(debit - credit), debits = 0, pr = 0, credits = 0, clbalance = 0
			from virtualgl
			where date < :ar_startdate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 7)
			group by acccode
			union all
			select acccode, opbalance =0, debits=sum(case when documenttype = 'PR' THEN 0 ELSE Debit END), pr = sum(case when documenttype = 'PR' THEN Debit ELSE 0 END), credits=sum(credit), clbalance=0
			from virtualgl
			where date >= :ar_startdate and date <= :ar_enddate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 7)
			group by acccode
			union all
			select acccode, opbalance=0, debits=0, pr = 0, credits=0, clbalance = sum(debit - credit)
			from virtualgl
			where date <= :ar_enddate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 7)
			group by acccode
			union all
			select acccode, opbalance=0, debits=0, pr = 0, credits=0, clbalance = 0
			from accounts
			where acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 7)
			group by acccode) a
	group by a.acccode) cstatus, SupplierCategory sc
where ac.subcode = 7 and 
	ac.acccode = cstatus.acccode AND
	s.suppcatcode  = sc.suppcatcode
ORDER BY name1, code1, suppliercategory
